name: Hajdúnánás (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Hajdúnánás: a blue shield with a red-clad figure holding a sabre, with a helm, an arm crest and red, blue and yellow mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Hajdúnánás arms with helm, crest and mantling
